summary: Production public copy and admin provider surfaces align with invite/comp-only mode while Stripe/payment provider integration is deferred. Paid and real-generation claims are hidden, and the dev provider is never presented as production generation.

coverage.runtime_probe: Production public-claims probe crawled public pages, billing policy, onboarding copy, and admin provider surfaces and verified real-generation and paid claims are hidden for invite/comp-only mode while Stripe evidence is deferred.
coverage.deployment_evidence: ops/evidence/production/public-paid-real-generation-claims.json records public copy tokens, hidden dev-provider labels, comp-only claim alignment, no mock-checkout readiness claim, no paid lifecycle claim, and provider evidence back-reference.
coverage.provider_audit_evidence: Claims evidence binds public policy audit au-020 to provider audit au-021 so legal/support pages, billing copy, and provider status cannot imply real production generation or paid launch without matching production provider and Stripe evidence.

coverage.runtime_probe: Production release-gate replay cleared production_provider_or_comp_only_mode and its two provider-related do-not-launch conditions for invite/comp-only mode while preserving paid billing, backup rollback, plus upstream CI and staging blockers.
coverage.deployment_evidence: The production gate fixture cites both exact provider mode files, clears only the provider-or-comp-only check, and keeps aggregate no-go status because Stripe paid billing and backup evidence remain separate launch blockers.
coverage.provider_audit_evidence: Gate preservation links au-021, the production gate fixture, and remaining blocker ids so comp-only provider readiness cannot imply paid billing, backup rollback, post-deploy smoke, CI, or staging readiness.
